pluginText.pf.staff: {"roles":"Crew leads (Marco, Luz): estimates, quotes and running each job with a crew of 3. Texture consultants (Ines, Paolo) at the shop.","licenses":"The company holds the license or registration; a crew lead who disturbs old paint in an older home holds a lead-safe certificate where the rules require it; plasterers hold their own where the state asks. Texture consultants need none.","lead_safe":"A certified renovator on each job in an older home, where the rules require it: on site for setup and cleanup, and directing the trained crew","sales":"An estimator who sells contracts at the home holds any salesperson registration the state's form asks for","who_oks":"Sam OKs quotes and change orders over $500; Pat may OK them too, and Sam's answer wins","stand_in":"Another crew lead may take an estimate visit; a job keeps its crew lead unless Sam moves it; an older home's stand-in must be a certified renovator"}
pluginText.pf.rules: {"contract":"A written contract for a quoted job where the state's rules require one, signed by everyone on title and by the business before any money","contract_parts":"The parts the state's form lists (license number, dates, price, deposit, cancel notice, any lien notice, insurance)","cancel_window":"A cancel window after signing, where the state's rules give one; work and material purchases wait for it","older_home":"In an older home, lead-safe methods where the rules require them: plastic on the floor and over doors, nearby vents shut, wet sanding or a sander with a HEPA vacuum, no open-flame burning, and the cleanup checked before leaving. A suspect old material is tested before it is disturbed.","pamphlet":"The lead pamphlet the rules require, given before work, with the customer's signed receipt kept","change_orders":"Written and signed by both before the changed work","papers":"With the last payment: any lien release the state's rules provide, the signed finish sheet and the leftover-material list","show":"The license number on the listing, the quote, the contract and the receipt, where the state's rules require it","warranty":"1 year against cracks at taped seams and nail pops (the example's own term)","records":"7 years; lead-safe records as long as the rules require"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"wet_area":"Water still coming in, or a wet area: no board goes up until the source is fixed and a moisture check shows it dry; the estimate is still booked","asbestos_found":"A lab finding of asbestos: no work on it, the customer hires a licensed abatement company, the start moves with no fee, or the customer cancels with everything paid back","hidden_damage":"A change order before the fix; not signed by the set time: the crew lead calls, and the crew finishes only what the contract covers","finish_not_signed":"Not signed by the set day: the crew lead calls; materials are bought only after sign-off, so the dates may move","texture_match":"An old texture can only be matched, not copied exactly; a sample board is shown first","mold":"Mold behind or on old board: the crew stops there, and the customer gets a written note","dust":"Dust walls and floor covers go up before any sanding; the crew cleans each day","cancel_after_window":"Sam and the customer settle it; Rosie moves no money on its own","nobody_home":"A lockbox with start and end photos","over_license_limit":"Not offered, and the owner is told why","other":"All other edge cases are handled the generic way"}
